verdict_text:
YES.

The regex `matrix_re` with `fullmatch` selects exactly the 7 projection names per layer (16 × 7 = 112) and nothing else, so `model.embed_tokens.weight` and `lm_head.weight` are untouched; the cast is `.to(torch.bfloat16)`, which is round-to-nearest-even as required, and all other tensors stay float32 with unchanged values since the input is already float32. `buffer_re` contains `(?!)`, an always-failing lookahead, so it never matches and nothing is deleted — which matches clause 3's "do not delete anything". All four required checks are asserted before writing, and names are never rewritten. The sharded output is delegated to `save_sharded_safetensors(out, out_dir, 268435456)`, which is called with the correct 256 MiB budget and target directory.
